verdict.rationale: LM Studio's documented value proposition is entirely local execution (download and run models locally, headless daemon, local REST API); there is no mention anywhere in the evidence of a hosted/cloud tier for offloading models too large for local hardware. Even the newer 'Bionic' agent references running frontier models but gives no indication of cloud hosting versus local execution, and community threads confirm the product is used strictly as a local runtime. missing for 10: any documented cloud/hosted inference tier, pricing or account model for cloud offload, or evidence of remote execution of oversized models.
